messages:
maya (customer): hey team — running into 429s from the API even though the project quota tile shows ~70% available. this started ~11:05 UTC. request id: r-0a1b2c3d.

jordan (support): sorry to hear that — can you paste the project_id and a curl example? and what endpoint are you hitting (chat vs completion vs embeddings)?

maya (customer): project: proj-47c9. hitting /v1/chat/completions. sample curl:```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
 -H "X-Request-ID: r-0a1b2c3d" 
 -d '{"model":"open-owl-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
```

jordan (support): thanks. quick check — can you confirm org-level usage? sometimes org shared pools can exhaust and still show per-project tiles as available due to snapshot lag. also what's the exact 429 payload?

maya (customer): 429 body: `\{"error\":\{"type\":\"rate_limit\",\"message\":\"project throughput exceeded\",\"retry_after\":3\}\}` — we see it on ~12% of requests over a short burst. dashboard shows project tile: limit 10r/s, rolling window 60s, used 3.2r/s. org tile shows plenty.

lee (eng): pinging infra — quick heads up: we saw a short ingestion lag in meter-collector last night that delayed windowed counts for ~40s in one shard. that can create temporary mismatches between live enforcement and dashboard tiles. grabbing query now.

lee (eng): repro SQL I ran on the ledger: ```sql
SELECT project_id, window_start, sum(requests) as requests
FROM windowed_usage
WHERE project_id = 'proj-47c9' AND window_start >= '2026-11-08T11:04:00Z'
GROUP BY project_id, window_start
ORDER BY window_start DESC;
```

lee (eng): result shows a spike at 11:04:22Z where aggregated ingestion from fanout arrived late and doubled the counted tokens for one window compared to realtime enforcement. enforcement is done from the token stream, dashboard from the materialized view — when fanout ingestion is delayed we can get transient 429s.

jordan (support): thanks lee. maya — two quick asks to help triage and, if you want, reproduce: 1) collect one raw API 429 response (full headers). 2) run the curl with `-H "X-Debug-Trace: 1"` to include the meter event id if it happens again. 3) are you using any SDK client-side batching?

maya (customer): ok doing that now. we do client-side small-batch (group messages into 2-3 per call) and sometimes use retries. attaching header dump when it happens next.

sam (billing): looping in billing — we also noticed an invoice for this org that has a token tally ~1.6% higher than the dashboard for last billing window. that could be the same ingestion duplication event. I can run a ledger diff if you want.

lee (eng): please run ledger diff: ```sql
SELECT source, sum(tokens) FROM token_ledger
WHERE org_id = 'org-9m' AND ts >= '2026-11-01' AND ts < '2026-11-09'
GROUP BY source;
```

sam (billing): will run and DM results. initial quick check shows small amount attributed to `fanout-replay` during 11/08 11:04 UTC.

ops-bot: deploy-notify: service/meter-collector rolled back automatically at 2026-11-08T11:05:02Z due to surge in consumer lag. incident# INC-2026-11-08-3 created.

jordan (support): ok — summary: likely root cause is transient ingestion duplication from fanout/replay which caused enforcement to see higher instantaneous counts (hence 429s) while dashboard materialized view lagged or showed conservative snapshots. next steps for us: 1) lee/eng to add a short-term mitigation to prevent double-counting on replay paths, 2) billing will run ledger reconciliation and, if customer billed for duplicated tokens, credit appropriately, 3) support to gather raw 429 headers + X-Debug-Trace if it reproduces.

maya (customer): appreciate it. please keep me posted — this affected a small % of production traffic but led to a bad UX for users. will share header dump if we hit again. :pray:

lee (eng): noted. filing follow-up ticket ENG-7429 to add dedupe on replay and to add a dashboard flag when materialized view lag > 15s.

sam (billing): will DM maya the temporary credit plan if ledger diff shows dup tokens.

jordan (support): re: repro steps, marking thread for follow-up. if you get another 429, include the header dump and the `X-Debug-Trace` value and we will correlate to meter logs immediately. tnx! :thumbsup:
